artboards.title: Mobile — lead direction, ink to paper
Alt C — the fee is the hero

annotations.text: Placeholders: the hero photo stands in for the dome-at-dusk ad image (same crop, same colour grade). The calendar card marks where the live HubSpot scheduler renders; it is drawn, not embedded.

Lead direction: the first screen stays on ink and orange for ad continuity, then the page turns to the agency's warm paper after the calculator, so the call agenda, proof, and the white HubSpot embed sit on a native surface instead of looking like holes in a dark page. The catch is the one dark block on paper, right before the calendar.

Two alternates beside the lead. Alt A keeps every section on ink with tactile dark cards: maximum continuity, but the white HubSpot calendar will always look pasted in. Alt C makes the fee the hero and demotes the photo to a card: strongest message match, weakest sense of place.
